resources.name: Animal Care Centers of NYC
resources.mission: "To End Animal Homelessness in NYC": We work with each animal individually to find the best placement & set them up for success. The greatest need is usually for large breed dogs, adult cats, and seasonally for underage kittens (under 8 weeks old). We will provide basic supplies for your foster pet including food, toys, cat litter, harnesses and leashes etc. We will also send you home with any medication your foster pet is on. We are available for behavior and medical support, as well as helping you find adopters for your foster pet.

resources.name: Animal Care Centers of NYC
resources.mission: "To End Animal Homelessness in NYC": This is for our community pets/surrender prevention program. This program helps provide services and resources to keep animals in their homes.

resources.name: Festival of Cinema Inc
resources.mission: Festival of Cinema, Inc. was developed to create a bridge between artists and the community. Our goal is to make Central Queens a popular destination where audiences can gather and view the work of undiscovered emerging filmmakers from around the world. In addition to bringing a world class event to the underserved neighborhoods within Central Queens, we aim to become an outlet for any individual, regardless of status, income, or background, who wishes to learn more about the film industry or pursue a career in that field. We are a 10-day film festival in Forest Hills now entering our 10th year of programming.

resources.name: Polonians to Minister to Our Community
resources.mission: The mission of the P.O.M.O.C. organization is to carry out social activities within the immigrant community of New York State, especially within the Polish-American community. Our work aims to improve the living conditions and enhance the quality of life of our clients.

resources.name: Ridgewood Jazz Fest Inc
resources.mission: The mission of Ridgewood Jazz Fest Inc is three-fold: to curate events for the community by connecting venues and artists, to create new music and works and to cultivate and develop local businesses and talent, and to provide low barrier and barrier-free opportunities for people of all ages to experience and be educated about world class music and learn about the history and future of jazz.
